answer_1.quote: We evaluate whether LLMs faithfully reflect their uncertainty when answering questions.
answer_1.outputs: short-form answers to factual questions, sometimes including hedging expressions

answer_2.quote: the mean faithful generation metric (MFG) quantifies the expected faithfulness of a single answer

answer_3.quote: we implement our decisiveness score (Eqn. 1) with a few-shot prompt P_d in which the LLM is instructed to extract the assertion and a score between 0.0 and 1.0

answer_4.quote: We evaluate the quality of our LLM-based scores, showing that they correlate well with human judgment.
answer_4.guideline: humans assigned perceived probabilities to hedging expressions; authors compared LLM confidence scores to labels written by the authors
